messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Stan web site contents
parts:
I just pushed a new directory stan/web with
one file, index.html, which contains a text-only
layout for the web page(s) and links. To
browse the contents, follow:

https://code.google.com/p/stan/source/browse/web/index.html

Overall, this should be much clearer for new users
than what we have on Google Code. I'll simplify what's
there to aim it squarely at developers, while pushing
people back to the main Stan home page for general
information.

With Malecki on the HTML, it should look great, too!

- Bob



index.html
======================================================================
STAN

Stan is a C++ package (runnable also from R) for obtaining Bayesian
inference using the No-U-turn sampler, a variant of Hamiltonian Monte
Carlo.

Download Latest
* Stan 1.0.0 (9 Aug 2012) [-> download/stan.html]
* RStan 1.0.0 (9 Aug 2012) [-> CRAN page, or a placeholder for now?]

Installation and Getting Started
* Stan Command-line [->]
* RStan [->]

Manuals
* Stan Modeling Language User Guide and Reference Manual [-> PDF]
* Model Examples [-> browse Git on Google Code?]

Source Repository [-> google code page]

Contact
* Stan User's Group [-> google groups page]
* Email [->mailto:mc-sta...@gmail.com]
* Bug Reports [-> Google Code Issue Tracker]

Stan Development Team [team.html]
======================================================================



download/stan.html
======================================================================
Download Latest
- Stan 1.0.0 [->stan-1.0.0.tgz on google code]

Licensing
- Stan is licensed under the new BSD license [-> link]
- RStan is licensed under the GPLv3 license [-> link]
- Stan depends on Eigen (MPL [->link]) and Boost (Boost license [->link]).
- Stan and RStan are copyrighted by the Stan Development Team [->link]
======================================================================



getting-started/rstan.html
======================================================================
Copy over Jiqiang's getting-started instructions from the Google Code
Wiki?
======================================================================



getting-starting/stan.html
======================================================================
There's a big section in the manual PDF, so we can just point people
to that. Or maybe copy it all over?
======================================================================



team.html
======================================================================
Copy over what's on the top of the Stan home page. But on its own
page, you can break us all out on our own lines rather than inlining.
======================================================================

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Stan web site contents
parts:
On 8/12/12 3:24 PM, Andrew Gelman wrote:
> B
> That looks great; thanks. Just a thought to avoid duplication:
> Would it makes sense to remove the "getting started" section from the manual and just there refer to the getting started instructions on the webpage?

The redundancy here is helpful because this is
one place we don't want users blocked.

Not everyone will read the manual. And not
everyone will find the getting started web page
no matter how prominent we make it.

- Bob
